Yoga’s effect on height is disputed. Several sources claim that specific yoga asanas can increase growth hormone and add up to an inch or a few centimeters, even after puberty or until about ages 23–24 [d2, d5, d8, d9, d11]. In contrast, other sources state that yoga cannot increase skeletal height after roughly age 20 and that any change is negligible or due to improved posture rather than actual growth [d1, d6, d12]. Additional sources note that yoga may improve posture and alignment, making you appear taller without changing your skeletal height [d3, d4, d7, d10].
